input.prompt: Locked camera, one continuous five-second shot with the provided intact delivery as the first frame and the provided crushed delivery as the last frame. During the first second the unattended delivery pile is still. A broad shadow crosses the cartons. Between seconds one and two, a single heavy dark wooden upright piano drops vertically from above the top of the frame onto the SAME central shipment, crushing the paper-cup cartons and bread crates together. The piano arrives from above at speed and lands heavily with realistic gravity; it never fades into existence. A short burst of cardboard dust, white paper cups and bread rolls scatter, then settle around the solid piano. The owner at the far-right doorway and worker by the far-left truck react with a restrained flinch, staying clear and unharmed. Both remain in their respective positions. The piano settles into the provided final position. One weighty impact and a brief discordant piano resonance, followed by street ambience. Photographic realism with dry absurdist humor. No explosion, injury, dialogue, music, text, camera cut, dissolves or morphing.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a live-action, cinematic static shot. On a sunlit city sidewalk, a delivery worker in a navy uniform stands on the left by his truck, while a deli owner in a dark apron stands on the right in his doorway, both flanking an unattended pile of cardboard boxes filled with paper cups and black crates holding bread rolls. At 00:00.500 within the same shot, a broad, dark shadow rapidly sweeps across the central stacked cartons. At 00:01.500 within the same shot, a heavy, dark wooden upright piano drops vertically into view from above the top edge of the frame, falling at a fast speed with realistic gravity. At 00:01.800 within the same shot, the piano lands squarely on the central shipment, accompanied by a loud, weighty impact thud and a sharp, discordant piano resonance. The heavy instrument instantly crushes the cardboard boxes flat and splinters the black plastic bread crates beneath its weight. At 00:02.500 within the same shot, a short burst of cardboard dust puffs outward into the air, as white paper cups and round bread rolls scatter violently across the concrete pavement. At 00:03.500 within the same shot, the worker by the truck and the owner by the door react simultaneously with a brief, restrained flinch, their shoulders tensing slightly, but they stay completely clear and unharmed. At 00:04.500 within the same shot, the dust dissipates and the scattered cups and bread settle around the solid, motionless piano, leaving both men standing frozen in their respective original positions, staring blankly at the absurd wreckage.

overall_soundscape: The scene opens with the steady, quiet ambient sounds of a bustling city street, including distant traffic and a light breeze. As the shadow passes, the ambiance is abruptly shattered by a loud, weighty, crushing thud when the piano strikes the pavement. This impact is immediately accompanied by a sharp, discordant burst of piano resonance in the foreground, as the internal strings vibrate violently from the sudden shock. Simultaneous with the thud, the loud crunch of flattening cardboard and the sharp crackle of splintering plastic crates are clearly heard. This is quickly followed by the light, hollow clatter of paper cups and the soft, muffled thuds of bread rolls scattering across the concrete. Toward the end of the clip, the chaotic metallic hum of the piano fades out, leaving only the return of the dry, everyday street ambience.
